recipes.title: Smoked Mackerel Avocado Mash
recipes.ingredients:
• 160g Smoked Mackerel
• 1 Ripe Avocado
• 1 tbsp Lemon juice
• 1/2 tsp Black pepper
• 1 tbsp Fresh Dill
recipes.instructions:
1. Flake mackerel into a bowl.
2. Add avocado and lemon juice.
3. Mash with a fork until chunky.
4. Stir in pepper and dill.
5. Serve on keto toast.

recipes.title: Flaxseed & Walnut N'oats
recipes.ingredients:
• 30g Ground Flaxseed
• 20g Walnuts
• 120ml Almond Milk
• 1/2 tsp Cinnamon
• 10g Chia Seeds
recipes.instructions:
1. Combine flax, chia, and milk in a pan.
2. Heat for 4 mins until thick.
3. Stir in cinnamon.
4. Top with walnuts.

recipes.title: Tofu Scramble with Spinach
recipes.ingredients:
• 200g Firm Tofu
• 100g Spinach
• 1/2 tsp Turmeric
• 1 tbsp Nutritional Yeast
recipes.instructions:
1. Crumble tofu into a pan.
2. Add turmeric and yeast.
3. Sauté for 5 mins.
4. Stir in spinach until wilted.

recipes.title: Chia & Berry Skyr Bowl
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix skyr and chia seeds.
2. Chill for 20 mins.
3. Top with berries.

recipes.title: Almond Savory Pancakes
recipes.ingredients:
• 100g Almond Flour
• 2 Eggs
• 50ml Almond Milk
• 1/2 tsp Baking Powder
recipes.instructions:
1. Whisk eggs and milk.
2. Mix in dry ingredients.
3. Fry in small portions for 2 mins per side.

recipes.title: Zucchini Walnut Muffins
recipes.ingredients:
• 150g Almond Flour
• 100g Grated Zucchini
• 2 Eggs
• 30g Walnuts
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients.
2. Pour into muffin tins.
3. Bake at 180°C for 25 mins.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Roll-ups
recipes.instructions:
1. Spread cheese on salmon.
2. Add cucumber sticks.
3. Roll and serve.

recipes.title: Oats Yogurt Fruit Bowl
recipes.instructions:
1. Layer yogurt over oats.
2. Top with berries.
3. Let sit for 5 mins.

recipes.title: Scrambled Eggs with Toast
recipes.ingredients:
• 4 Eggs
• 2 slices Seeded Toast
• 30ml Milk
• 10g Butter
recipes.instructions:
1. Whisk eggs and milk.
2. Melt butter in a pan.
3. Scramble eggs gently.
4. Serve on toast.

recipes.title: Yogurt Oats Bowl
recipes.ingredients:
• 200g Greek Yogurt
• 30g Oats
• 1 tsp Chia
• 15g Walnuts
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix yogurt, oats, and chia.
2. Wait 15 mins.
3. Top with walnuts.

recipes.title: Omelette with Feta
recipes.instructions:
1. Whisk eggs.
2. Pour into oiled hot pan.
3. Top with feta, fold and serve.

recipes.title: Avocado & Egg on Toast
recipes.ingredients:
• 1 slice Seeded Bread
• 1/2 Avocado
• 1 Poached Egg
recipes.instructions:
1. Toast bread.
2. Mash avocado and spread.
3. Top with poached egg.

recipes.title: Berry Nut Protein Smoothie
recipes.ingredients:
• 30g Whey Protein
• 50g Frozen Berries
• 1 tbsp Almond Butter
• 200ml Water
recipes.instructions:
1. Place all in blender.
2. Blend until smooth.

recipes.title: Mushroom & Cheese Frittata
recipes.instructions:
1. Sauté mushrooms.
2. Pour over whisked eggs.
3. Top with cheese and grill.

recipes.title: Herb-Crusted Baked Cod
recipes.ingredients:
• 300g Cod fillets
• 40g Almond Flour
• 1 tbsp Olive Oil
recipes.instructions:
1. Coat fish in almond flour.
2. Drizzle with oil.
3. Bake at 200°C for 15 mins.

recipes.title: Turkey & Zucchini Stir-fry
recipes.instructions:
1. Fry turkey.
2. Add zucchini.
3. Stir in soy sauce.

recipes.title: Walnut Tofu Steaks
recipes.instructions:
1. Brush tofu with mustard.
2. Press into nuts.
3. Fry until golden.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Chicken Salad
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix all.
2. Toss with olive oil.

recipes.title: Mushroom Cauliflower Risotto
recipes.instructions:
1. Sauté mushrooms.
2. Add cauliflower and cook until soft.
3. Add cheese.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Baked Herring
recipes.instructions:
1. Rub fish with garlic.
2. Top with lemon.
3. Bake for 18 mins.

recipes.title: Beef & Broccoli Stir-fry
recipes.ingredients:
• 250g Beef Steak
• 200g Broccoli
• 2 tbsp Soy Sauce
recipes.instructions:
1. Sauté beef.
2. Add broccoli.
3. Add sauce and toss.

recipes.title: Tuna Potato Bowl
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix tuna and potatoes.
2. Top with boiled egg.

recipes.title: Spiced Bean Bowl
recipes.instructions:
1. Sauté beans and cumin.
2. Add spinach.

recipes.title: Tofu Lentil Bolognese
recipes.instructions:
1. Sauté tofu.
2. Add lentils and tomatoes.
3. Simmer for 20 mins.

recipes.title: Turkey Burgers
recipes.ingredients:
• 500g Ground Turkey
• 1 Egg
• 1 tsp Garlic powder
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix and form patties.
2. Grill for 6 mins per side.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Chicken Bake
recipes.ingredients:
• 2 Chicken Breasts
• 1 Bell Pepper
• 1 tbsp Olive Oil
recipes.instructions:
1. Toss with oil.
2. Bake for 25 mins.

recipes.title: Veggie Burger
recipes.instructions:
1. Mash chickpeas.
2. Mix with egg and crumbs.
3. Fry until crisp.

recipes.title: Turkey Burger Wrap
recipes.ingredients:
• 1 Turkey Patty
• 2 Lettuce leaves
• 1 tbsp Mustard
recipes.instructions:
1. Wrap patty in lettuce.
2. Add mustard.

recipes.title: Veggie Burger Wrap
recipes.ingredients:
• 1 Veggie Patty
• 2 Lettuce leaves
• 1 tbsp Hummus
recipes.instructions:
1. Spread hummus on lettuce.
2. Wrap patty.

recipes.title: Trout with Almond Flour
recipes.instructions:
1. Coat trout in flour.
2. Sauté for 3 mins per side.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Herbs
recipes.ingredients:
• 2 Salmon fillets
• 1 tbsp Herbs
• 1 tbsp Olive oil
recipes.instructions:
1. Rub herbs and oil on fish.
2. Bake at 200°C for 12 mins.

recipes.title: Cod with Spinach
recipes.instructions:
1. Pan fry cod.
2. Sauté spinach with garlic.
3. Serve together.

recipes.title: Tuna & Bean Salad
recipes.ingredients:
• 160g Tuna
• 200g Cannelini Beans
• 1 tbsp Olive Oil
recipes.instructions:
1. Rinse beans.
2. Mix with tuna and oil.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken with Broccoli
recipes.ingredients:
• 2 Chicken Breasts
• 200g Broccoli
• 1 tbsp Olive Oil
recipes.instructions:
1. Toss chicken and broccoli in oil.
2. Bake for 20 mins.

recipes.title: Tofu with Mixed Veggies
recipes.ingredients:
• 250g Tofu
• 200g Mixed Veg
• 1 tbsp Soy Sauce
recipes.instructions:
1. Fry tofu.
2. Add veg and sauce.
3. Stir fry for 5 mins.

recipes.title: Golden Flax Seed Bread
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix into dough.
2. Bake at 180°C for 45 mins.

recipes.title: Almond Flour Rolls
recipes.ingredients:
• 150g Almond Flour
• 3 Egg Whites
• 1 tsp Psyllium husk
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix into a sticky dough.
2. Form 6 rolls.
3. Bake for 25 mins at 170°C.

recipes.title: Keto Seed Crackers
recipes.ingredients:
• 100g Sunflower seeds
• 50g Chia seeds
• 50g Flax seeds
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix with water to make a paste.
2. Spread thin on a tray.
3. Bake at 150°C for 50 mins.

recipes.title: Walnut Bread
recipes.instructions:
1. Blend walnuts.
2. Mix all ingredients.
3. Bake in a tin for 35 mins.

recipes.title: Spinach & Feta Muffins
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix and pour into muffin tins.
2. Bake at 180°C for 20 mins.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
recipes.instructions:
1. Squeeze dry zucchini.
2. Mix all ingredients.
3. Bake for 40 mins.

recipes.title: Herb Scones
recipes.ingredients:
• 150g Almond Flour
• 1 Egg
• 1 tbsp Dried Herbs
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix into a dough.
2. Shape into 6 scones.
3. Bake for 15 mins.

recipes.title: Cheese Biscuits
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix and roll into balls.
2. Flatten and bake for 12 mins.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Seed Loaf
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix seeds and flour.
2. Add eggs and bake for 40 mins.

recipes.title: Chive & Onion Rolls
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix all.
2. Form 6 rolls.
3. Bake for 20 mins.

recipes.title: Chocolate Brownies
recipes.ingredients:
• 150g Dark Choc
• 100g Butter
• 100g Erythritol
• 50g Almond Flour
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt choc and butter.
2. Stir in flour and erythritol.
3. Bake for 20 mins at 170°C.

recipes.title: Avocado Choc Mousse
recipes.instructions:
1. Blend all until smooth.
2. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: Berry Jelly
recipes.instructions:
1. Dissolve gelatine in water.
2. Mix in berries.
3. Set in fridge.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cups
recipes.ingredients:
• 100g Peanut Butter
• 50g Dark Choc
• 1 tbsp Coconut Oil
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt choc.
2. Layer PB and choc in cases.
3. Freeze.

recipes.title: Coconut Macaroons
recipes.instructions:
1. Whisk whites.
2. Fold in coconut and sweetener.
3. Bake for 15 mins.

recipes.title: Yogurt Bark
recipes.instructions:
1. Spread yogurt on a tray.
2. Top with berries.
3. Freeze and break.

recipes.title: Almond Cookies
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix and roll into cookies.
2. Bake for 12 mins.

recipes.title: Lemon Tart (Keto)
recipes.instructions:
1. Bake flour crust.
2. Mix eggs and lemon.
3. Bake until set.

recipes.title: Chia Pudding
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix and chill overnight.
2. Serve with berries.

recipes.title: Baked Pears
recipes.instructions:
1. Halve pears.
2. Sprinkle with nuts and bake.
